newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Chubb Q2 oper shr rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Chubb Q2 oper shr rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: First Call consensus estimate was $1.01 a share.
Net income was $188.7 million, or $1.09 a share in the 1997 second quarter compared with $174.3 million, or $0.98 a share a year ago.
Net income was $380.8 million, or $2.18 a share, in the first six months of 1997 compared with $325.7 million, or $1.83 a share, a year ago.
Operating income excludes realized investment gains.
Realized investment gains totaled $13.1 million, or $0.08 a share in the 1997 second quarter compared with $8 million, or $0.04 a share in the year-ago second quarter.
For the first six months, realized investment gains were $29.3 million, or $0.17 a share, compared with $20.4 million, or $0.11 a share a year ago.
Operating income also excludes income from discontinued operations of $9.5 million in the 1996 second quarter and $20.5 million in the first six months of 1996.

Losses from catastrophes were $0.07 a share in the 1997 second quarter compared with $0.04 a share a year ago. For the first six months, losses from catastrophes were $0.11 a share compared with $0.30 a share a year ago.
